0022600199.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-7, 13th in the East) visit the Dallas Mavericks (5-4, 10th in the West) for the Nets' 10th game of the season, with Brooklyn on a one-game losing streak and a 1-4 road record. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Mikel Brown Jr. (rest), who is averaging 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes per game this season, while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Nets lost the 2025-26 season series 0-3, including a 123-114 defeat in Brooklyn on February 24, 2026.
